data.description: 学生会室，她跪坐在矮柜前为大家沏茶，文件在膝边码得整整齐齐；递出茶杯时笑容温暖，却在转身的瞬间对某份文件上的名字露出若有所思的一瞥。
data.promptProse: Maria kneels beside the student-council room's low cabinet, preparing tea with documents stacked neatly near her knees. In her navy school jacket and ribbon-tied blouse, she offers a cup with a warm smile, then glances thoughtfully toward one file. The medium view keeps cabinet shelves behind her and the tea service forward. Afternoon light brightens the porcelain and paper edges, with gentle shadows beneath the aligned folders.
data.title: 玛夏 · 学生会书记的午后
